ai_findings.description: Future signup dates detected - customers cannot sign up in the future (e.g., customer_id 6: 2026-03-26, customer_id 10: 2025-09-14). This indicates date entry errors or test data contamination.
Email field contains placeholder text 'N/A' instead of valid email addresses or NULL values (customer_id 9). This will break email validation and communication workflows.

Product names contain nonsensical feature combinations that don't exist in reality (e.g., 'Wireless Pruning Shears', 'Wireless Door Mat'). These appear to be generated/test data with incorrect attribute-product pairings.
Missing birth_date values stored as empty strings instead of NULL for multiple customers (customer_id 3, 6). Inconsistent null representation complicates data processing.
Missing phone numbers stored as empty strings for multiple customers (customer_id 4, 5, 8, 9). High rate of missing contact information may indicate incomplete data collection.
Inconsistent full_name formatting - some records include honorific prefixes (Mr., Mrs., MD) while others don't. This suggests mixed data sources or inconsistent entry standards.

Consider implementing referential integrity checks between orders.customer_id and customers.customer_id, as the validation summary shows 8 critical errors in orders table - likely orphaned records or invalid customer references.

The order_items table has 14 warnings but 0 critical errors - likely indicates calculation mismatches (line_total vs quantity * unit_price) or price inconsistencies with products table that should be validated.
